latest_release.body:
# Usagi [1.2](https://github.com/UsagiApp/Usagi/releases/tag/v1.2)

**This is Usagi - v1.2, 7th stable version. Just read manga your own way!**

## What's different

This stable release focuses primarily on adding features related to the user interface, behavior and user experience.

Additionally, this build includes enhancements for [TsukiMix](https://github.com/UsagiApp/TsukiMix) to ensure smoother, faster operation and fixes crashes associated with certain components.

We also look forward to this stable version being the foundation for developing even more new features in the future!

**_Happy reading!_**

## What's changed

- Allow to show / hide category section in favorites category
- Allow to show / hide new chapters barge in library
- Collapse "Add to favourites" chip on overflow in details interface
- Clean up coil for plugin cover image (by @sang765)
- Clean up Android manifest, removed some unused values
- Expand duplicate manga detection capabilities, improve performance
- Fixed some crash cases with source settings
- Force follow selected image for actions in reader interface
- Force follow reading order with reversed chapters list
- Removed custom title for RPC, merge manga name to RPC title
- Removed some duplicated Android resources
- Updated some dependencies, translations from Weblate
- Suspend db transactions while interacting with sources catalog
- Prevent duplicate manga results on feed interface
- Protobuf parsing support for external repos / stores (by @sang765)

**Thanks @sang765 for your contributions and all translators with new updates from our [Weblate](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/usagi/): @dragonx943, @Ph1l0s64, @AgenteGabrielofc, @daminokun. Thank you everyone for following and using Usagi.**

**Full Changelog**: You can check it [here](https://github.com/UsagiApp/Usagi/compare/v1.1...v1.2) (from GitHub, `devel` branch)
